name: tia_set_technology_object_parameters
description: Write existing parameters of one technology object in place by their 'Name in Openness', e.g. Config.InputPerOn or Config.ActivateCooling for PID_Temp. Every value is a string that is converted to the CLR type of the parameter's current value (Boolean true/false, integers and floating point in invariant culture). All names and values are validated before anything is written; then they are written in order and each is verified by read-back. Not transactional: if a later write fails, earlier writes stay and the result has Partial=true. Read the names first with tia_get_technology_object_parameters.

parameters.description: Non-empty list of parameters to write, in order; each name at most once.

value.description: New value as an invariant-culture JSON string, e.g. true, 5 or 0.5 sent as a string.

plc_name.description: Exact PLC software name (case-sensitive); required when the project has multiple PLCs.
